title: GE Fleet Services Australia - proposed acquisition of Custom Fleet Australia

body_sections.Summary: GE Fleet Services Australia Pty Ltd- proposed acquisition of Custom Service Leasing Ltd
body_sections.Market definition: The Australian market for car fleet leasing and management
body_sections.Competition analysis: GE Fleet Services and Custom Service Leasing (Custom Fleet) both provide commercial vehicle fleet management and financing. A large number of competitors offer similar services, barriers to entry are low and customers have a high degree of countervailing power.  Consequently, the acquisition is unlikely to substantially lessen competition.
